notes: Experimental (#189): validated triaxial semiaxes with a separate orthonormal pose; not part of the PrimitiveShape3 pair matrix and not consumed by Physics Engine.

Support, support radius, AABB extents and halfspace sweeps are checked against an independent 96x192 latitude/longitude sampled surface (inscribed hull) at a named 1.1e-3 relative tolerance across 1:1:1, 1.5:1:1, 4:1:1, 0.3:2:0.7 and 50:0.05:1 shapes; inertia is checked against midpoint grid integration.

Radius containment, orientation invariance, positive direction scaling and 1e-150..1e150 scale covariance are metamorphic properties; both rotating-motion displacement certificates bound every sampled material point.
deterministicPerformance: Every query is a fixed closed-form scalar sequence with no iteration or scratch; Divan cases in benches/primitive3.rs are developer evidence.
criterion: Developer timings use the existing Divan primitive3 suite (ellipsoid module); no Criterion suite is added.
